text: Before Warranty Claims goes live to all 150 users at Cascade Ridge Outfitters, Devon Okafor runs one more check: real user acceptance testing.
Three West reps, two East reps, and both regional managers -- Hannah Reyes and Tobias Lindgren -- create real sample claims the way they actually would on a support call.
Every claim Devon tests routes correctly: West claims land in the West queue, East claims land in the East queue, every time.
Two small issues get caught and fixed on the page layout. Devon also demos the Warranty Claims by Region report for Hannah and Tobias -- from his own screen.
Next: training all 150 users and taking Warranty Claims live across Sales and Service.
